newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in moderate trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased 4.26 points to 3294.61 on Friday in moderate trading, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 9.712 million shillings on 251,994 shares compared to 22.277 million shillings on 625,717 shares on Thursday.

Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 85 from 90 while Barclays Bank edged up a shilling to close at 102. Diamond Trust Bank Kenya was unchanged at 30 while Standard Chartered Bank closed at 43.50 unchanged.
Brokers said trading was slow and the bourse would remain sluggish except for counters where there was foreign demand.
Rea Vipingo Plantations closed at 9.05 while Sasini Tea & Coffee gained 2.0 to 78.
"No major moves are expected until about June," a senior broker said.
"Reporting time for most companies is over, and the market is cooling off," a market analyst said.
Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 124 while Total Kenya closed at 64.50 from 63. Uchumi Supermarkets eased to 37.25 from 37.50 while Kenya Airways closed at 8.05 from 8.50.
Meantime Industrial & Commercial Development Corporation announced an interim dividend of two per one held.

The group posted a profit of 50.554 million shillings ($0.93 million) after tax for the year ended December 31, 1996 compared to 61.727 million shillings in the previous year. The share closed at 43 from 42.75.
